info.title: Results API
info.description: REST API for managing match results

get.description: Returns the match result associated with the specified identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the result

put.description: Fully updates an existing match result.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the result to update

delete.description: Deletes the match result associated with the specified identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the result to delete

get.description: Returns the client associated with the specified identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the client

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the client to update

delete.description: Deletes the client associated with the specified identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the client to delete

get.summary: Get a paginated list of results
get.description: Returns match results matching the given filters (all optional), paginated and sortable. String filters match partially and case-insensitively; id, score, and date filters match exactly.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact result identifier

parameters.name: homeTeam
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the home team name

schema.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the home team name

parameters.name: awayTeam
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the away team name

schema.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the away team name

parameters.name: homeScore
parameters.description: Exact number of goals scored by the home team

schema.description: Exact number of goals scored by the home team

parameters.name: awayScore
parameters.description: Exact number of goals scored by the away team

schema.description: Exact number of goals scored by the away team

parameters.name: matchDate
parameters.description: Exact match date

parameters.name: competition
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the competition name

schema.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the competition name

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the venue name

schema.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the venue name

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.description: Creates and persists a new match result.

get.summary: Get a paginated list of clients
get.description: Returns clients matching the given filters (all optional), paginated and sortable. String filters match partially and case-insensitively; id and creation timestamp filters match exactly.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact client identifier

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the first name

parameters.name: lastName

parameters.name: email

schema.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the email address

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the phone number

schema.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the phone number

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the address

schema.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the address

parameters.name: createdAt
parameters.description: Exact creation timestamp

parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

parameters.name: size
